import os

log_path = "logs/app-2026-09-17.log"
if os.path.exists(log_path):
    print(f"File exists: {log_path}, size: {os.path.getsize(log_path)} bytes")
    with open(log_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as f:
        lines = [f.readline() for _ in range(20)]
    print("Sample lines:")
    for l in lines:
        if l.strip():
            print(l.strip())
else:
    print(f"File not found: {log_path}")
    print("Listing logs directory:")
    print(os.listdir("logs") if os.path.exists("logs") else "logs dir not found")
